about:
# GDPulse!

<cj>GDPulse!</c> is a powerful Geode mod that lets you <cg>monitor your real-time heart rate</c> directly in Geometry Dash.  

It integrates seamlessly with Pulsoid, giving you full control over your <cy>pulse tracking</c> experience while playing.  

Key Features:  
- <cg>Connect your Pulsoid account</c> and keep your pulse synced in real-time  
- <cj>Account linking</c> toggle for personalized tracking  
- <cc>Pulse reconnection</c> button if your heart rate isn’t showing  
- Fully customizable <cg>UI scale and position</c> for your heart rate display  
- <cj>Custom heart icon position</c> (left/right or custom X/Y coordinates)  

Check the supported devices here!!  
- Supported devices link: [Pulsoid supported monitors](https://blog.pulsoid.net/monitors)

<cj>Stay in rhythm with your heartbeat</c> and enjoy a more immersive gaming experience!
